# Zooza Developer Docs

> Zooza is ready-made backend infrastructure for businesses that run classes,
> courses and activities (kids' clubs, swimming, dance, music, sports, language
> schools, franchises). Instead of building booking and billing logic from
> scratch, developers build their own websites, forms and apps on top of the
> Zooza REST API and embeddable widgets.

Zooza already handles the parts that are hard to get right:

- Class booking and registration forms, including trial classes and waiting lists
- Make-up sessions: entitlement, capacity and expiry rules enforced automatically
- Installments, subscriptions and recurring payments, with Stripe and GoCardless integrations
- Integrations with accounting and local payment systems
- Class and course listings, schedules, venue and franchise maps
- Multi-company networks (franchises, multi-brand operators)

Getting access is self-serve: create a free Zooza account at https://signup.zooza.online,
then request a REST API key from Zooza support (support@zooza.online). Widgets only
need the widget API key shown in the Zooza admin under Team & Settings > Publish. The API runs in three regions
(Europe, UK, UAE) with stable, versioned endpoints described by an OpenAPI 3.0 spec.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.zooza.online/quickstart/): Five-minute guide to embedding your first widget or making your first API call.
- [Concepts & Glossary](https://docs.zooza.online/concepts/): Definitions for all Zooza-specific terminology — programmes, classes, sessions, places, blocks, and more.

## How Zooza handles it

- [Make-up sessions](https://docs.zooza.online/make-up-sessions/): How make-ups (replacement classes) are earned, limited, expired, scoped and booked; extra capacity for full classes, waiting lists, custom make-ups; widget and API usage.

## AI

- [AI assistants & MCP](https://docs.zooza.online/ai-assistants/): How coding agents should use these docs and the OpenAPI spec; the Zooza MCP server (https://mcp.zooza.app/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth with Zooza login) for running classes, bookings and attendance from Claude and other MCP clients.

## Integration examples

- [Examples overview](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/): Real-world integration patterns with copy-paste code, built on a fictional kids' activity business.
- [Multi-step trial booking form](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/multi-step-trial-booking/): Step-by-step trial class sign-up (age-group tiles, trial session picker, details, payment) configured without custom code.
- [Branded course and session tiles](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/branded-booking-tiles/): Restyle the booking widget with CSS, or render your own tiles with render_course_tile / render_schedule_tile and course metadata.
- [Location map](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/location-map/): Branch and franchise map with postcode search, radius filter and classes per venue, using the map widget.
- [Filtered timetable](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/filtered-timetable/): Server-rendered weekly timetable from the REST API (schedules, courses, places) with filters and deep links into booking.
- [Custom catalogue](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/custom-catalogue/): Custom programme catalogue and class picker; CMS owns content, Zooza owns classes, availability, waiting lists and booking.
- [AI chatbot with the logged-in client](https://docs.zooza.online/examples/chatbot-logged-in-client/): Pass the logged-in parent from Zooza into a website chatbot and answer booking questions safely via your backend and the REST API.

## API Reference

- [API Overview](https://docs.zooza.online/api/): When to use the REST API, base URLs by region, authentication summary.
- [Authentication](https://docs.zooza.online/api/authentication/): How to get a REST API key; passwordless auth via email verification, PIN code, or client_secret. Includes code examples.
- [Error Handling](https://docs.zooza.online/api/errors/): HTTP status codes, error response format, common error scenarios, and debugging tips.
- [API Operations](https://docs.zooza.online/api/reference/): Full REST API reference — all endpoints with request/response schemas.
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://docs.zooza.online/zooza_api_v1.yaml): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specification (full API contract).

## Widgets

- [Widget Overview](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/): Installation options (WordPress, Wix, embed code), cookies, customer journey patterns.
- [Embed Methods](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/embed-methods/): Ways to load Zooza widgets on a website.
- [Registration Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/registration-widget/): Booking and class registration form — settings, filters, analytics events, callbacks.
- [Buyer-Only Extra Fields](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/registration-widget-buyer-fields/): Registration form fields collected once per buyer instead of per attendee.
- [Calendar Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/calendar-widget/): Real-time class schedule and availability views — settings, custom sessions import.
- [Map Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/map-widget/): Location-based venue and class search with map view.
- [Profile Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/profile-widget/): Customer portal — booking history, payment management, make-up session booking.
- [Event Documents](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/event-documents/): Session-attached documents and galleries shown to participants in the profile widget.
- [Video Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/video-widget/): Secure video content embedding for logged-in users.
- [Checkout Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/checkout-widget/): Sells products, including entry passes with a payment plan; product chosen via ?product= in the page URL.
- [Checkout Widget v2 (deprecated)](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/checkout-widget-v2/): Legacy v2 checkout, kept for existing embeds.
- [Contact Widget](https://docs.zooza.online/widgets/contact-widget/): Contact form that turns website enquiries into Zooza contacts — form configurations, hidden fields, campaign attribution, spam protection, styling, analytics events.

## Reference

- [Enums Reference](https://docs.zooza.online/enums/): All enumeration values used across the API and widgets, including supported languages.
- [Full documentation as one file](https://docs.zooza.online/llms-full.txt): All prose pages concatenated in Markdown.
